_about: Public-domain John Mitchell Mason (1770-1829), Associate Reformed pastor in New York, founder of its seminary and president of Dickinson College, for the Word Hoard: the Oration on Alexander Hamilton (1804), A Plea for Sacramental Communion on Catholic Principles (1816) and The Complete Works of John M. Mason (4 vols, 1849), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 56 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jmmason-hamilton: Oration, commemorative of the late Major-General Alexander Hamilton : pronounced before the New-York state society of the Cincinnati, on Tuesday, the (New-York, Printed by Hopkins and Seymour and sold by G.F. Hopkins, at Washington's head, no. 118, Pearl-street, 1804)
jmmason-sacramental-communion: A Plea for sacramental communion on catholick principles (New York : Whiting and Watson, 1816)
jmmason-works-1: The complete works of John M. Mason, D.D, vol. 1 (New York : Baker and Scribner, 1849)
jmmason-works-2: The complete works of John M. Mason, D.D, vol. 2 (New York : Baker and Scribner, 1849)
jmmason-works-3: The complete works of John M. Mason, D.D, vol. 3 (New York : Baker and Scribner, 1849)
jmmason-works-4: The complete works of John M. Mason, D.D, vol. 4 (New York : Baker and Scribner, 1849)

_alternates.jmmason-writings-1832: The Writings of the late John M. Mason (1832, 4 vols): the earlier collection, superseded by the 1849 Complete Works
_alternates.jmmason-sermons-1860: Sermons, Lectures and Orations (1860), a selection from the same works

_excluded.jmmason-other: John Mason of Water-Stratford (1646-1694) and John Mason the Nonconformist (Self-Knowledge, 1745) are other men; Essays on the Church of God (1843) duplicates the Works
